policy.decision: Apply only these five explicit human-reviewed current-canonical Production NULL assignments from deterministic SHA1(lowercase person_id UUID string) shard 5. Preserve any existing non-null value as authoritative and fail closed on conflict. No role-to-domain automation and no scope expansion.

review_scope.partition: SHA1(lowercase person_id UUID string) first hex == 5
review_scope.rationale: Livia Drusilla is represented primarily by her sustained political authority and influence within the Augustan regime; Lobengula was king of the Ndebele Kingdom; the Lord of Sipán was the paramount Moche ruler represented at Sipán; Ma Bufang exercised substantive regional governing authority in Qinghai in addition to military command; Manuel Amador Guerrero was the first constitutional president of Panama. Governance is therefore the representative domain for all five after individual historical review.
